national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Holds Trilateral Meeting with UAE and US Counterparts in Mumbai
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S. Jaishankar held a trilateral meeting with UAE Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Mumbai.
Bilateral trade between India and the UAE has crossed 100 billion US dollars following the implementation of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA).
Discussions during the meetings focused on strengthening ties in trade, energy, technology, defense, connectivity, and addressing regional issues including the West Asia crisis.

national_news.title: Nation Celebrates Dussehra with Leaders Emphasizing National Unity and Good Governance
bullets: The festival of Dussehra (Vijaya Dashami), marking the triumph of good over evil, was celebrated nationwide with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Droupadi Murmu gracing events in New Delhi.
Prime Minister Modi called upon political parties and national institutions to stand united in the national interest and confront divisive forces.
The Prime Minister reiterated the government's vision of achieving 'Ram Rajya' through good governance while progressing toward the goal of 'Viksit Bharat'.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Addresses 25th SCO Council of Heads of Government Meeting
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the 25th Meeting of the Council of Heads of Government of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) in Dushanbe, Tajikistan.

He emphasized that regional connectivity projects must be based on consultation, respect for sovereignty, and territorial integrity, highlighting the International North-South Transport Corridor and Chabahar Port.
The Defence Minister called for unified global action to dismantle the entire ecosystem of terrorism, stressing zero tolerance for terrorism and rejecting double standards.

national_news.title: India’s Medal Tally Reaches 30 at Asian Para Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya
bullets: India's medal tally at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, reached 30, comprising 7 gold, 10 silver, and 13 bronze medals.
Pranav Soorma won gold in the men’s discus throw F51/52/53 event, setting a new Asian record of 11.66 metres in the F51 category.
Other gold medalists included Simran (Women’s 200m T12 with a Games record of 24.80 seconds) and Deepthi Jeevanji (Women’s 400m T20 with a Games record of 56.36 seconds).

national_news.title: Indian Railways inaugurates new broad gauge lines in Chhattisgarh
bullets: Inaugurated Tadoki-Rowghat (17.5-km) and Abhanpur-Kurud broad gauge lines in Chhattisgarh.
The 95-km Dalli-Rajhara-Rowghat line project was completed at a cost of 1,628 crore rupees.
The project aims to connect remote regions like Bastar to the national rail grid, boosting socio-economic growth, trade, and healthcare access.

national_news.title: India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement Comes into Force
bullets: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA) came into force, providing duty-free access for 100 per cent of Indian exports to New Zealand.
Both nations agreed to work towards doubling bilateral trade in goods and services to approximately Rs 35,000 crore by 2030.
Sensitive sectors like dairy remain protected, while New Zealand committed to facilitate USD 20 billion in investments into India.

national_news.title: India Records Over $748 Billion in FDI Inflows Between 2014 and 2025
bullets: India received a record over USD 748 billion in Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) between 2014 and 2025, with source countries rising from 89 to 112.
FDI norms were progressively liberalized, permitting up to 74 per cent in defense and 100 per cent in telecom, insurance, and space sectors.
Key sectoral reforms aim to create a more investor-friendly environment and position India as a preferred global investment destination under the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.

national_news.title: India and Saudi Arabia Discuss Bilateral Electrical Interconnection Initiative
bullets: Pankaj Agarwal, Secretary of the Ministry of Power, held a virtual bilateral meeting with Nasser Al-Qahtani, Assistant Minister of Energy for Electricity Affairs, Saudi Arabia.
Discussions focused on the proposed electrical interconnection between India and Saudi Arabia to deepen bilateral energy cooperation.
Both sides explored cooperation in Extra High Voltage (EHV) transmission systems, renewable energy grid integration, data centre power requirements, and grid code updates.
